messages.text:
"A cyberpunk game, very similar to Arclight City and Cybercode Online, featuring its own anime/cyberpunk art style, megacities, diverse NPCs, and all the content of the aforementioned games. It must be completely offline and have a complex and deep skill progression system, a branching narrative based on ethical choices that change the world, and a dynamic soundtrack that reacts to the environment and the player's state. Simultaneously, it should boast realistic and dark cityscapes with advanced lighting effects that create an immersive atmosphere, animated character designs in an anime style, and realistic/cyberpunk city styles. The game should also feature a highly customizable turn-based tactical combat system with implants, weapons, equipment, equipment rarities, and detailed crafting systems to progressively improve the protagonist's abilities. Furthermore, it should offer complete customization of the main character, including appearance, starting attributes, and full body, allowing for adjustments to every physical and personality detail. The story should be set in 2077 with branching missions and a deep open world that reacts to your decisions, a world with many interconnected cities linked by futuristic and diverse transportation systems. explorable biomes, with NPCs, world events and NPCs that make the world feel real, all in a 2D game very similar to Cybercode Online and Arclight City, completely offline.
"
